json.hint: Runtime operation 'config_reload' could not notify any active tasks because the watch channel is closed.

json.title: Internal error

plain_lines: Runtime operation 'config_reload' failed: watch channel closed
An unexpected internal error occurred. This is likely a bug in ft.
• Runtime operation 'config_reload' could not notify any active tasks because the watch channel is closed.
• If the runtime is shutting down, restart `ft watch` before retrying.
Run `ft why FT-9001` for more details.
